title: Scalar Ext external cup agrees with the ordinary module cup of pullbacks
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], f:X -> Spec k and g:Y -> Spec k be schemes [def-pc-scheme], F on X and G on Y arbitrary module sheaves, and p,q natural numbers. For any ordinary module cup product cup of pr1^*F and pr2^*G characterized by IsModuleCupProduct [def-sc-module-cohomology-cup-product], and x in scalarCohomology(f,F,p), y in scalarCohomology(g,G,q) [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations], externalCup(f,g,F,G,p,q,x,y), on its underlying module-cohomology carrier, equals cup(moduleCohomologyPullback(pr1,F,p,x), moduleCohomologyPullback(pr2,G,q,y)) [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap]. No Cech cover, comparison, cochain, or total cycle is assumed.

source.place: Tag 01F7 (cohomology-section-functoriality), Tag 0FKV (cohomology-lemma-diagrams-commute), and Varieties Tag 0BED (varieties-equation-kunneth-on-cech); agent-written scalar Ext specialization of these operations.

proof.text: Represent module classes by injective-resolution cocycles and identify the unit-module morphisms evaluated at 1 using moduleExtEquiv. Exact scalar restriction preserves these morphisms and their cocycle equations. Since the scalar pullback coefficient has adjoint the same tensor-pullback unit, its scalar pullback class is the ordinary module pullback class.

Compute both cups on an acyclic resolution pairing. The scalar tensor coefficient sends pure tensors to tmulSection and the signed differential agrees with the ordinary module pairing. The scalar Ext product therefore gives the paired cocycle class. IsModuleCupProduct identifies it with cup of the ordinary pullback classes. Resolution comparison and homotopy independence remove all choices. The composition of the scalar pullbacks and scalar cup is the definition of externalCup.

theorem scalarExternalCup_moduleComparison
    {k : Type w} [Field k] {X Y : Scheme.{w}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) (p q : ℕ)
    (cup : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (Limits.pullback f g).toRingedSpace p).obj
        ((tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F) →ₗ[Γ(Limits.pullback f g, ⊤)]
      (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (Limits.pullback f g).toRingedSpace q).obj
        ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj G) →ₗ[Γ(Limits.pullback f g, ⊤)]
      (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (Limits.pullback f g).toRingedSpace (p + q)).obj
        (externalCupCoefficients f g F G))
    (hcup : IsModuleCupProduct ((tensorPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F)
      ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd f g)).obj G) p q cup)
    (x : scalarCohomology f F p) (y : scalarCohomology g G q) :
    externalCup f g F G p q x y =
      cup (moduleCohomologyPullback (pullback.fst f g) F p x)
        (moduleCohomologyPullback (pullback.snd f g) G q y)
